title: Netherlands to return 20 looted objects, including 38-carat diamond, to Indonesia
title_zh: 荷兰将向印度尼西亚归还20件被掠夺物品，其中包括一颗38克拉的钻石。
description: The Netherlands will return 20 cultural objects taken during the colonial era to Indonesia. The artifacts include the 38-carat Banjarmasin diamond that once belonged to the sultan of Banjarmasin.
description_zh: 荷兰将向印度尼西亚归还殖民时期掠夺的20件文化物品，其中包括曾属于班贾尔马辛苏丹的38克拉班贾尔马辛钻石。

title: Paywalls have become the dominant revenue engine for Dutch newspaper publishers
title_zh: 付费墙已成为荷兰报纸出版商的主要收入来源。
description: Newspaper publishers have reportedly enjoyed years of steady revenue growth as an increasing number of readers prove willing to pay for news.
description_zh: 据报道，随着越来越多的读者愿意为新闻付费，报纸出版商多年来一直享受着稳定的收入增长。

title: Feyenoord climb to first place in the Eredivisie after 2-0 win over AZ in De Kuip
title_zh: 费耶诺德在德库伊普2-0战胜阿尔克马尔，升至荷甲第一
description: Feyenoord beat AZ Alkmaar 2-0 at De Kuip in Rotterdam on Saturday in the Eredivisie.
description_zh: 周六，荷甲联赛在鹿特丹德库伊普球场，费耶诺德队以2-0击败阿尔克马尔队。

title: Some Dutch rinks open despite warm October
title_zh: 尽管十月天气温暖，一些荷兰溜冰场仍然开放。
description: Many Dutch artificial ice rinks reopened last week, despite temperatures being around 20 degrees, NOS reports.
description_zh: 据荷兰广播公司NOS报道，尽管气温在20摄氏度左右，但上周荷兰许多人工冰场重新开放。

title: "Workers aren't putting up with this anymore," union says as bus drivers plan strikes
title_zh: 工会表示：“工人们再也无法忍受这种情况了”，公交车司机正计划罢工。
description: Regionalpublic transportemployees are set to walk out en masse in protest on Wednesday, Octob
description_zh: 区域公共交通员工计划于10月10日星期三举行大规模罢工抗议。

title: Dutch turn in 7,650 kg of fireworks in first nationwide drop-off campaign
title_zh: 荷兰首次全国性烟花回收活动上交了7650公斤烟花。
description: People brought in about 7,650 kilograms of fireworks during the firstnationwide campaign
description_zh: 在第一次全国性活动中，人们带来了约7650公斤烟花。

title: Police arrest driver after 200 km/h chase near Den Bosch
title_zh: 警方在登博斯附近以200公里/小时的速度追逐后逮捕了司机
description: Police chased a driver Friday evening, who fled at a speed of up to 200 kilometers per hour, police reports.
description_zh: 警方报告称，周五晚间，警方追捕一名逃逸司机，该司机逃逸速度高达每小时 200 公里。

title: Real estate agents now also report that grid congestion is delaying housing projects
title_zh: 房地产经纪人现在也反映，电网拥堵正在延误住房项目。
description: Problems related to the overloaded grid network in the Netherlands continue popping up, FD reports.
description_zh: 据FD报道，荷兰电网过载相关的问题仍在不断出现。

title: Power outage halts trains around Schiphol, cancels services to Utrecht, Venlo, Dordrecht
title_zh: 停电导致史基浦周边火车停运，并取消前往乌得勒支、芬洛、多德雷赫特的服务
description: Due to a power outage, no trains are running around the Schiphol Airport. Services to Utrecht, Dordrecht, and Venlo have also been cancelled.
description_zh: 由于停电，史基浦机场周边所有列车停运。开往乌得勒支、多德雷赫特和芬洛的列车服务也已取消。

title: Belgian court praises Dutch police in case of toddler allegedly killed by babysitter
title_zh: 比利时法院赞扬荷兰警方在保姆涉嫌杀害幼童一案中的出色表现。
description: The court of assizes in Ghent on Friday expressed its appreciation for the Dutch police investigation into the abduction and death of the
description_zh: 根特巡回法庭周五对荷兰警方调查绑架和死亡事件表示赞赏。

title: Researchers raise doubts about WWII account of imprisonment in Dachau concentration camp
title_zh: 研究人员对二战时期关于达豪集中营监禁情况的记载提出质疑
description: Two researchers have independently raised doubts that Dutch Second World War veteran Willem Wilbrink (99) was ever imprisoned in the Dachau concentration camp, as he has told at countless
description_zh: 两位研究人员分别独立地对荷兰二战老兵威廉·威尔布林克（99岁）是否真的像他无数次讲述的那样被关押在达豪集中营表示怀疑。

title: French-inspired bouillon restaurants rapidly gain popularity across the Netherlands
title_zh: 法式风味的肉汤餐厅在荷兰迅速走红
description: A significant new restaurant trend is taking over the Dutch culinary scene: the rapid rise of "bouillon" restaurants.
description_zh: 荷兰餐饮界正在兴起一股重要的新潮流：那就是“bouillon”餐厅的迅速崛起。

title: MP’s want to set minimum amount for mandatory wages for interns
title_zh: 议员们希望为实习生设定最低强制工资标准。
description: Several parties in the Tweede Kamer, the lower house of Dutch parliament, want the government to set a minimum amount for its proposed mandatory internship allowance.
description_zh: 荷兰议会下院（Tweede Kamer）的几个政党希望政府为其提议的强制性实习津贴设定最低金额。

title: Video: Arson near Delfshaven railway bridge halts all trains between Rotterdam, Delft
title_zh: 视频：德尔夫沙芬铁路桥附近发生纵火案，导致鹿特丹至德尔夫特之间的所有列车停运。
description: A fire near the Delfshaven railway bridge, which was reported at around 2:30 a.m.
description_zh: 凌晨2点30分左右，德尔夫沙芬铁路桥附近发生火灾。

title: Dutch PM Jetten calls U.S. sanctions on ICC "highly regrettable," seeks dialogue
title_zh: 荷兰首相杰滕称美国对国际刑事法院的制裁“令人深感遗憾”，并寻求对话。
description: The Netherlands stands "fully behind the ICC,” and the U.S.sanctionsagainst the cou
description_zh: 荷兰“完全支持国际刑事法院”以及美国对该国的制裁。

title: Another housing protest to take place on Amsterdam's Dam Square as shortage persists
title_zh: 由于住房短缺持续存在，阿姆斯特丹水坝广场将再次爆发住房抗议活动。
description: Another housing protest will take place on the Dam Square in Amsterdam on Saturday at 2 p.m.
description_zh: 另一场住房抗议活动将于周六下午2点在阿姆斯特丹水坝广场举行。

title: Overasselt security guard was not to be at work the night of the murder
title_zh: 凶杀案发生当晚，保安人员本不应该上班。
description: A number of details about the deadly Overasselt shooting have emerged more than a month later.
description_zh: 一个月后，有关致命的奥弗阿塞尔特枪击案的诸多细节浮出水面。

title: Man sentenced to 10 years for 2017 killing of Tilburg woman
title_zh: 男子因2017年杀害蒂尔堡女子被判处10年监禁
description: The court in Breda has sentenced Werner de R., 44, from Tilburg to 10 years in prison for the fatal stabbing of 58-year-old Hennie de Laat in Tilburg in 2017.
description_zh: 布雷达法院判处来自蒂尔堡的 44 岁男子 Werner de R. 10 年监禁，罪名是他在 2017 年于蒂尔堡刺死了 58 岁的 Hennie de Laat。

title: Dutch retailers launch scam monitor after 1.2 million victims of fake webshops
title_zh: 荷兰零售商推出诈骗监控系统，此前已有120万人受骗于虚假网店
description: Dutch online retailers are joining forces against fake webshops after the number of people in the Netherlands scammed by such sham stores rose to 1.2 million last year.
description_zh: 去年，荷兰有 120 万人因虚假网店诈骗，荷兰在线零售商正联合起来打击虚假网店。

title: PSV beat Heerenveen 2-0 in first game after the international break
title_zh: 国际比赛日后的首场比赛，埃因霍温2-0战胜海伦芬。
description: PSV pick up a 2-0 win against Heerenveen in the first Eredivisie game after the international break.
description_zh: 在国际比赛日后的首场荷甲联赛中，埃因霍温以 2-0 战胜海伦芬。

title: Video evidence shows Rotterdam woman was driving in fatal Aruba crash, OM says
title_zh: OM表示，视频证据显示，在阿鲁巴岛发生的致命车祸中，肇事司机是一名鹿特丹女子。
description: The Aruba Public Prosecutor’s Office (OM) has said that Kimberly van Ardenne, a 23-year-old woman from Rotterdam who died in a UTV crash on Aruba, was driving the vehicle herself.
description_zh: 阿鲁巴公共检察官办公室 (OM) 表示，在阿鲁巴发生的一起 UTV 事故中丧生的 23 岁鹿特丹女子 Kimberly van Ardenne 当时是自己驾驶车辆。

title: U.S. threatens to cripple ICC as Trump administration imposes new sanctions
title_zh: 美国威胁要削弱国际刑事法院，特朗普政府实施新的制裁
description: The United States is imposing additional sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, according to a statement.
description_zh: 据一份声明称，美国将对位于海牙的国际刑事法院（ICC）实施额外制裁。

title: Dutch government delays new plan to cover billions in Box 3 tax shortfall
title_zh: 荷兰政府推迟了弥补第三类税收缺口数十亿欧元的计划
description: The Dutch government is expected to present a revised plan to fund its proposed changes to the Box 3 tax on income from assets later this month, according to multiple sources in The Hague.
description_zh: 据海牙多位消息人士透露，荷兰政府预计将于本月晚些时候提出一项修订计划，为其拟议的资产收入税第三类税种的改革提供资金。

title: GVB wants to launch self-driving minibuses in Amsterdam within 3 years
title_zh: GVB计划在三年内在阿姆斯特丹推出自动驾驶小巴。
description: Amsterdam public transport company GVB wants to launch self-driving minibuses in the Dutch capital within three years.
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹公共交通公司 GVB 希望在三年内在荷兰首都推出自动驾驶小巴。

title: Dutch bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA, and Babboe to continue under new Singaporean owner
title_zh: 荷兰自行车品牌 Batavus、KOGA 和 Babboe 将在新加坡新东家的领导下继续运营。
description: Dutch bicycle brands Batavus, KOGA, and Babboe are set to resume operations under new ownership.
description_zh: 荷兰自行车品牌 Batavus、KOGA 和 Babboe 将在新的所有权下恢复运营。

title: Unrest at another gov't agency will further delay overdue child support payments
title_zh: 另一政府机构的动荡将进一步延误拖欠的子女抚养费支付。
description: People waiting for overdue child support must wait longer for help because of problems at the Landelijk Bureau Inning Onderhoudsbijdragen (LBIO).
description_zh: 由于 Landelijk Bureau Inning Onderhoudsbijdragen (LBIO) 的问题，等待逾期子女抚养费的人必须等待更长时间才能获得帮助。

title: Trump administration sanctions International Criminal Court
title_zh: 特朗普政府制裁国际刑事法院
description: The United States has announced sweeping sanctions against the International Criminal Court (ICC), escalating Trump’s war on the international tribunal....
description_zh: 美国宣布对国际刑事法院（ICC）实施全面制裁，进一步升级了特朗普对该国际法庭的攻击……

title: Russia wants NL to hand over ICC judges
title_zh: 俄罗斯要求荷兰交出国际刑事法院法官
description: Russia has asked the Netherlands to hand over nine International Criminal Court (ICC) officials who were convicted in absentia last...
description_zh: 俄罗斯已要求荷兰引渡九名国际刑事法院（ICC）官员，这些官员于去年被缺席判刑……

title: Dutch Minister enlists Ghana to help catch drug fugitive Bolle Jos
title_zh: 荷兰大臣请求加纳协助抓捕毒枭博勒·乔斯
description: Minister David van Weel of Justice and Security has enlisted the help of Ghana in the hunt for Dutch drug trafficker Jos Leijdekkers, better known as Bolle Jos, the Telegraaf
description_zh: 据《电讯报》报道，荷兰司法与安全部长戴维·范·维尔已请求加纳协助追捕荷兰毒贩乔斯·莱德克斯（Jos Leijdekkers），他更为人熟知的名字是“博勒·乔斯”（Bolle Jos）。

title: Video: Limburg town lifting homes with hydraulic jacks to protect against high water
title_zh: 视频：林堡镇用液压千斤顶抬升房屋以防止洪水侵袭
description: Three homes near the village of Well in Noord-Limburg will be raised by more than 1.5 meters to make them better protected against high water levels.
description_zh: 北林堡省韦尔村附近的三栋房屋将被抬高 1.5 米以上，以更好地抵御高水位。

title: Sole Dutch medicinal cannabis firm declared bankrupt
title_zh: 荷兰唯一一家医用大麻公司宣布破产
description: Bedrocan, the Dutch medicinal cannabis grower, was declared bankrupt on Thursday after requesting a suspension of payments two weeks ago.
description_zh: 荷兰医用大麻种植商 Bedrocan 在两周前申请暂停支付后，于周四被宣布破产。

title: English FA fines Dutch footballer Martin Sherif £5,000 for betting on 61 matches
title_zh: 英格兰足总因荷兰足球运动员马丁·谢里夫参与61场比赛的赌博活动，对其处以5000英镑的罚款。
description: The English Football Association (FA) has fined Martin Sherif £5,000, or around €5,897, for violating its gambling regulations.
description_zh: 英格兰足球总会（FA）因马丁·谢里夫违反其赌博法规，对其处以 5000 英镑（约合 5897 欧元）的罚款。

title: Van Gogh Museum renovations get green light as museum, gov't agree on funding
title_zh: 梵高博物馆翻修工程获准启动，博物馆与政府就资金问题达成一致。
description: The Van Gogh Museum in Amsterdam and the Ministry of Education, Culture, and Science (OCW) have reached an agreement on funding the renovation of the museum building.
description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹梵高博物馆与荷兰教育、文化和科学部 (OCW) 就博物馆大楼的翻新工程提供资金达成协议。

title: Fmr. ICC Judge Navanethem Pillay wins Nobel Peace Price
title_zh: 前国际刑事法院法官纳瓦内特姆·皮莱荣获诺贝尔和平奖
description: This year’s Nobel Peace Prize has gone to former judge and UN human rights chief Navanethem Pillay.
description_zh: 今年的诺贝尔和平奖授予了前法官、联合国人权事务高级专员纳瓦内特姆·皮莱。

title: Bus and train strikes to hit regional transport weekly until Christmas
title_zh: 公交车和火车罢工将每周影响区域交通，直至圣诞节。
description: Bus and train drivers are going to strike for one day a week up to Christmas, the trade unions FNV and CNV have announced.
description_zh: 工会FNV和CNV宣布，公交车和火车司机将在圣诞节前每周罢工一天。

title: Dutch woman denies kidnapping in trial over toddler beaten to death by ex-boyfriend
title_zh: 荷兰女子否认绑架罪名，其幼童被前男友殴打致死案正在审理中。
description: “There was never any kidnapping,” Romy W., 29, told the Court of Assizes in Ghent on Friday.
description_zh: “根本没有发生任何绑架事件，”29 岁的罗米·W 周五在根特巡回法庭上说道。

title: U.S.’s constant backpedaling frustrated Ukraine allies, says fmr. PM Schoof
title_zh: 前总理舒夫表示，美国不断退缩的做法令乌克兰盟友感到沮丧。
description: Former Dutch Prime Minister Dick Schoof says the Trump administration’s shifting approach to Russia and Ukraine left European countries struggling to keep up.
description_zh: 荷兰前首相迪克·舒夫表示，特朗普政府对俄罗斯和乌克兰政策的转变让欧洲国家难以跟上步伐。

title: 35 Groningen clubs, museums, events jointly ban smart glasses over privacy infringements
title_zh: 格罗宁根35家俱乐部、博物馆和活动场所联合禁止使用智能眼镜，理由是侵犯隐私。
description: Groningen’s cultural sector has taken a stand against AI smart glasses.
description_zh: 格罗宁根的文化界人士已公开反对人工智能智能眼镜。

title: Unions call regional transport strike, threaten weekly walkout
title_zh: 工会号召区域交通运输罢工，威胁每周举行罢工
description: Regional bus services across the Netherlands will be heavily disrupted on Wednesday, after the FNV and CNV unions called a...
description_zh: 周三，荷兰各地的区域巴士服务将受到严重干扰，此前FNV和CNV工会发起了一项罢工……

title: Podcast: The Bamboo Boards and BBB Bunnies Edition
title_zh: 播客：竹板与 BBB 兔子篇
description: Want to support the DutchNews podcast so we can replace our withered bamboo underpants? Click here to become a Patreon...
description_zh: 想支持DutchNews播客，让我们能换掉那条破旧的竹纤维内裤吗？点击这里成为我们的Patreon赞助人……

title: Former ICC judge Navi Pillay awarded Nobel Peace Prize
title_zh: 前国际刑事法院法官纳维·皮莱荣获诺贝尔和平奖
description: South African jurist Navi Pillay, who has served as a judge at both the International Criminal Court and the International...
description_zh: 曾任国际刑事法院和国际刑事法院法官的南非法学家纳维·皮莱……

title: Museums, festivals and clubs in Groningen ban smart glasses
title_zh: 格罗宁根的博物馆、节日庆典和俱乐部禁止佩戴智能眼镜
description: In a joint statement on Friday some 30 cultural organisations in Groningen announced they were banning the use of smart...
description_zh: 周五，格罗宁根约30家文化机构发表联合声明，宣布禁止使用智能设备……

title: NL’s only legal medicinal cannabis grower goes bust
title_zh: 纽芬兰省唯一一家合法医用大麻种植商破产
description: Patients who use medicinal cannabis face having to switch to imported products after the only licensed grower in the Netherlands...
description_zh: 荷兰唯一一家获得许可的种植商倒闭后，使用医用大麻的患者将不得不改用进口产品……

title: MPs vote to fly rainbow flag at parliament for first time
title_zh: 议员投票决定首次在议会升起彩虹旗
description: The rainbow flag will fly at the Dutch parliament building on Sunday, Coming Out Day, after MPs overturned a decision...
description_zh: 在议员们推翻一项决定后，彩虹旗将于周日（出柜日）在荷兰议会大厦升起……

title: MPs push for legal changes after pro-Hamas demonstration on Dam
title_zh: 在水坝发生支持哈马斯的示威活动后，议员们推动法律修改。
description: MPs are calling for a bill criminalising support for terrorist organisations to be pushed through faster, after demonstrators carried a...
description_zh: 在示威者举起……之后，议员们呼吁加快推进一项将支持恐怖组织定为犯罪的法案。

title: Maastricht area plans 30 care zones to tackle loneliness
title_zh: 马斯特里赫特地区计划设立30个关爱区以应对孤独问题
description: A new plan by care agencies and insurance companies aims to create 30 residential care zones in the Maastricht-Heuvelland area...
description_zh: 护理机构和保险公司的一项新计划旨在马斯特里赫特-赫弗兰地区建立30个养老院区域……

title: Support for swimming lessons often fails to cover costs for disabled children
title_zh: 对游泳课的资助往往不足以支付残疾儿童的费用。
description: A study conducted by the Mulier Instituut has stated that existing financial support for sport and swimming lessons for children with disabilities often does not cover the actual costs or is diffic
description_zh: 由穆利尔研究所进行的一项研究表明，目前对残疾儿童体育运动和游泳课程的财政支持往往不足以支付实际费用，或者难以覆盖所有费用。

title: Dutch café payment points pressure diners into excessive tipping, expert says
title_zh: 专家称，荷兰咖啡馆的收银台迫使顾客支付过多的小费
description: As a growing number of Dutch hospitality businesses continue offering a screen prompt asking customers to pay a 5, 15, or 20 percent tip, some visitors and experts
description_zh: 随着越来越多的荷兰餐饮企业继续在屏幕上提示顾客支付 5%、15% 或 20% 的小费，一些游客和专家对此表示不满。

title: Smoke plume over Amsterdam due to fire at Olympic Stadium; Blaze under control
title_zh: 阿姆斯特丹奥林匹克体育场发生火灾，上空浓烟滚滚；火势已得到控制。
description: A fire at the Amsterdam Olympic Stadium caused a lot of smoke over the Dutch capital on Thursday evening.
description_zh: 周四晚间，阿姆斯特丹奥林匹克体育场发生火灾，导致荷兰首都上空浓烟滚滚。

title: Parliament votes to fly rainbow flag on Coming Out Day as schools join Purple Friday
title_zh: 议会投票决定在“出柜日”升起彩虹旗，学校也加入“紫色星期五”活动。
description: A parliamentary majority approved flying the rainbow flag on the Tweede Kamer building on Coming Out Day.
description_zh: 议会多数派批准在“出柜日”当天在议会大厦升起彩虹旗。

title: Autumn has well and truly arrived, but temps could again climb to 20°C next week
